bullets.text: Built a privacy-first RAG pipeline that documents legacy PHP/JS codebases with no code leaving company infrastructure: LangChain ingestion, 2,000-character chunking, Linq-Embed-Mistral embeddings in local Chroma vector databases, and Llama 3 via Ollama; retrieval surrounds each chunk with related cross-file context, achieving a 90% reduction in manual documentation work.
Developed an automated call-quality assessment tool using WhisperX transcription and prompt engineering for LLM analysis, replacing manual QA audits.
Ran internal workshops on LLM capabilities and prompt engineering, accelerating adoption of AI tooling across the development team.
